title: The Chess with the King
summary: The King challenged Nasruddin to a game of chess, boasting that no one in the realm could defeat him....
full_text:
The King challenged Nasruddin to a game of chess, boasting that no one in the realm could defeat him.

Nasruddin played brilliantly, checkmating the monarch in twelve moves. Enraged, the King seized the heavy wooden chessboard and struck Nasruddin across the shoulders with it.

A week later, the King demanded another game. When Nasruddin saw he was about to deliver checkmate again, he quickly leaped under the table with a pillow tied over his head!

"What are you doing under the table?" demanded the King.

"Sire," replied Nasruddin from beneath the cushions, "I am delivering checkmate! But I have prepared my defenses beforehand!" The King laughed and rewarded his wit.
moral: Playing games with tyrants requires losing with grace and winning with discretion.
